highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with the latest upstream rendering corrections.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback may choose a different fontconfig face; applications requiring deterministic typography should use an explicit or bundled typeface.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change text metrics or glyphs. Use an explicit family and style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer advances to m153 and incorporates the latest upstream bug, correctness, and buffer-upload fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream bug-fix sync.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the 4.153 preview line.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp receives native build-warning cleanup in this release.
